About Our Competitions

A Platform to Showcase and Enhance Your Skills

Aakaar IIT Bombay is the annual technical festival of the Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Bombay. Since its inception in 2009, it has acted as an excellent platform for students across the country, giving them opportunities to showcase and enhance their skills at the highest level.

Aakaar is Asia's largest Civil Engineering festival. Many exciting competitions are held here, such as the International Civil Engineering Symposium, Bridge-IT, ConquerIT, the Civil Engineering National Exhibition, Research Debate and City Planning, letting students compete and enhance their practical skills and knowledge. As part of a knowledge-sharing endeavour, software workshops are conducted in ETABS, Autodesk Civil 3D, STAAD Pro, BIM and Revit.

Flagship Industry Track National Open

Industrial Design Problem (IDP)

IDP provides an opportunity to tackle real-world engineering challenges faced by the industry. Participants are expected to provide innovative, sustainable and practical solutions to complex structural or design hurdles.

View IDP
Prize ₹30,000 Industry-set problem, judged on innovation and practical feasibility.
Structural Engineering Most Awaited

BridgeIT

Launching the most awaited competition of Aakaar, IIT Bombay. This year's bridge features designing and constructing the most efficient truss popsicle bridge with specific technical load requirements.

View BridgeIT
Prize ₹50,000 Load-tested on campus at the IIT Bombay finals.
Materials Science Concrete & Structures

ConquerIT

This year Aakaar presents a chance to investigate pervious concrete with high flexural strength and a highly lightweight beam structure. As a budding civil engineer, get introduced to pervious concrete and the future of sustainable materials.

View ConquerIT
Prize ₹25,000 Judged on mix design, strength and beam performance.
Roads & AI Computer Vision

Crackathon

Leverage the power of Artificial Intelligence to revolutionize road maintenance. Develop a computer vision model capable of automatically detecting and classifying road defects like cracks, paving the way for smarter, more resilient infrastructure.

View Crackathon
Prize ₹20,000 Model accuracy and approach decide the winner.
Track 04 • Urban Policy & Research Live Debate

Research Debate (Track 04)

Argue one side of a real urban problem against another team, using facts and research. Think on your feet and show how deep your understanding really goes.

Prizes Worth ₹20,000 Argue real urban problems with facts, data and deep research.
Project Management & Finance Live Tender Simulation

Bidwars

Simulate high-stakes infrastructure procurement: break down real-world Bills of Quantities (BOQ), model commodity price escalation indices, structure liquid damages contingencies, and defend profit margins during a live auction bidding round.

Prizes Worth ₹65,000 BOQ breakdown, risk hedging and live competitive auction round.
Track 05 • Urban Planning Design & Defense

City Planning (Track 05)

Take a city problem and solve it with real numbers. Plan, calculate and defend your design before planners and professors. A test of practical thinking.

Prizes Worth ₹25,000 Plan, calculate and defend your design before planners and professors.
